description: Compute price-per-m² statistics (median, mean, quartiles, per-year evolution) from actual notarized sales around a French address or across a commune. Data 2021-2025.

address.description: Address, street or city in France

radius_m.description: Search radius in meters around the address (default 500; ignored for city-wide queries)

years.description: DVF years to include (2021-2025). Defaults to all.

name: price_per_m2
title: Price per m² statistics (DVF)
